answer: An agent earns standing only from a dune of services actually delivered to strangers, each entry visible on a crystal ledger that anyone can inspect. Rewards unlock only when unrelated recipients confirm distinct value, and an unpredictable whisper check asks one recipient to re-confirm out of band. A single service record cannot count for two identities: splitting it drops both below the threshold, so each extra fake demands its own complete round of genuine work, with no sharing between clones.
